long long pw[20];

		len++;
	}

}

	long long n;

	pw[0]=1;
	for(int i=1; i<=18; i++) {
		pw[i]=pw[i-1]*10+1;
		//cout<<pw[i]<<endl;
	}
	ans=1e9;
	dfs(n,0);
	cout<<ans<<endl;
	return 0;
}
